title: Stemmio AI conversation composer draft v1
$comment: The unsent Composer content for one Conversation. It is kept in its own small record so a debounced draft write never rewrites the message history. A draft never enters a Request, Prompt, USER_SUPPLEMENT or Candidate. Forward compatible: unknown members are preserved through read, edit and write.

intent.$comment: The Composer intent switch position. It is the same control in every state and only its second option changes.
